tiers.everyday: The Pummerin is the great bell of St. Stephen's Cathedral in Vienna. The first one, made from captured cannon in 1711, shattered in the 1945 fire; the new bell weighs about 20 tonnes.
tiers.student: The cathedral gives the 1951 bell as 20,130 kg, 313.6 cm across, wall 23 cm, note c°+4; it was consecrated in 1952 and hung in the North Tower in 1957, with a 637 kg clapper from 2011. Its predecessor (1711) fell and broke in April 1945.
